description: Bornes wifi - Réseau Val de Loire Wifi Public - CA Territoires Vendômois is a dataset listed in data.vendome.catv open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Val de Loire Numérique. Ce jeu de données recense toutes les bornes qui diffusent le réseau wifi Val de Loire Wifi Public sur le terrioire CA Territoire Vendômois. Un Wifi territorial est une solution d’accès à internet gratuite, portée par un acteur public. Coverage: Territoires Vendômois (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are bornes, wifi, reseau public. The portal shows 66 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-vendome-catv41-centrevaldeloire-portal.
